fields.field: chainId=56, ABI/selectors, EIP-1167 init code, formula literals and fixed oracle domain/type hashes
fields.source: Pinned historical runtime code, semantically replayed calldata and signed-digest derivation
fields.recompute: Outside hotpath: resolve and qualify a new profile; never silently retain old literals

fields.source: All witnessed executable code plus created clone init code; per-account codehash inventory below
fields.invalidation: Proxy implementation, delegate registry, extension, converter or config change; reorg
fields.recompute: Outside hotpath rebuild and re-verify code closure; local version swap atomically
fields.guard: Unknown code or changed delegate target => SKIP

fields.field: Global registries, proxy slots, quote configuration, launcher parameters, fee exemptions, signer roles
fields.source: Historical storage read closure below, including hasRole storage proven by revoked-role counterfactual
fields.invalidation: Any write to dependency slot; new caller/signer/mode; block rollback or feed gap
fields.recompute: State owner updates immutable versioned snapshot off hotpath; invalidate pending derived quotes on relevant delta

fields.field: Launch sender balances, allowances, factory pair/salt-collision state and any external existing account read
fields.source: Pre-launch account and storage read set; successful full launch simulation requires sender funding/allowance and no deployment collision
fields.invalidation: Sender transaction/replacement/cancel, approval/transfer, salt reuse, factory deployment, relevant storage mutation
fields.recompute: Maintain selected account/state coverage before admitting candidate; locally apply ordered deltas
fields.guard: New uncached launcher/account/signer/salt-state cannot trigger synchronous lookup: SKIP

fields.field: Launch metadata, salt, tokenVersion=6, quoteToken=DOGE, quoteAmt, taxes, dividend settings, extension ID and payload
fields.source: Complete newTokenV6 calldata; exact 26-field ABI roundtrip plus 116-frame launch execution
fields.invalidation: Replacement launch calldata/value/sender; unsupported parameter branch
fields.recompute: Decode once locally, reject unsupported code/mode; regenerate dependent launch state
fields.guard: Incomplete signal, another tokenVersion/quote/extension mode => SKIP until separately qualified

fields.field: New token, tax processor, dividend tracker, pair addresses and initialized storage
fields.source: CREATE2 and launch execution; 106 changed storage comparisons, created bytecode checks; local zero initialization only after verified creation
fields.invalidation: Salt/initcode/deployer change, collision, factory/launcher/extension mutation, replacement launch
fields.recompute: Recompute from calldata and matching pre-resident snapshot; zero cannot be assumed for existing contracts
fields.guard: Deployment absence/collision precondition must be in cache or deterministically established for that admitted candidate

fields.field: Signed quote price, digest, recovered signer and oracle deadline
fields.source: Runtime literal constants + quoteToken/salt/tokenVersion/mode/price/deadline; independently calculated EIP-712 digest and actual ECRECOVER/hasRole execution
fields.invalidation: Signature/price/deadline/mode change or signer role/code/domain change
fields.recompute: Decode/digest/recover locally against cached roles; never fetch a price on hotpath
fields.guard: Signature and allowed role required; insufficient expiry margin => SKIP

fields.field: r/h/k and creator post-launch reserve/supply, fee/tax balances and token state
fields.source: Full launch replay from pre-launch state plus calldata; arithmetic constants from executed trade runtime
fields.invalidation: Launch replacement or relevant global config/fee/extension/creator state changes
fields.recompute: Local integer arithmetic or qualified semantic implementation on same snapshot; re-evaluate after relevant delta
fields.guard: Reject unsupported token/tax/extension branches; no observed output input

fields.field: Current Portal token-state, exemption and token/tax/dividend state after launch
fields.source: Launch-derived base plus ordered relevant state deltas; all 65 intervening transactions classified for historical first BUY
fields.invalidation: Any relevant intervening TX or reorg, competing BUY/SELL, different caller
fields.recompute: Apply ordered deltas to cached state off hotpath; invalidate quote on dependency write
fields.guard: Unresolved ordering or a missing relevant delta => SKIP; historical quiet interval is not a future guarantee

fields.field: Historical router V2 pair reserves, balances and path fee multiplier
fields.source: Pair slots 6/7/8, token balances, runtime and calldata path; complete first-BUY EVM replay
fields.invalidation: Any swap/mint/burn/sync/transfer affecting pool, fee/path/code change
fields.recompute: Update local pool snapshot; integer conversion re-evaluated at signal
fields.guard: No RPC quote or pool reserve fetch on hotpath; route is evidence only, not the planned direct route

fields.field: Direct-Portal native-to-DOGE V3 conversion: slot0, liquidity, fee/ticks/bitmap/observations, balances and callback state
fields.source: All actual V3/converter/storage reads in 50-frame direct BUY replay; code executes rounding and callback validation
fields.invalidation: Pool swap/liquidity/tick/observation/balance changes, fee or converter registry update
fields.recompute: Maintain a bounded supported price/tick window off hotpath and compute swap locally
fields.guard: Out-of-cache tick/window, unsupported path or stale pool => SKIP; no claim that every future V3 swap fits this historical read set

fields.field: Execution-time timestamp and oracle/tax/pool time branches
fields.source: Chain header is an EVM input; oracle allows block.timestamp <= signed deadline; equality/+1 counterfactuals tested
fields.invalidation: Clock uncertainty, deadline crossing, token tax-phase boundary, delayed inclusion, reorg
fields.recompute: Use cached chain clock plus conservative admissibility bounds; recalculate time-dependent quote locally within qualified branch
fields.guard: Future block timestamp is NOT knowable at ingress; if relevant execution window crosses a branch or deadline => SKIP; delayed inclusion may still revert

fields.field: BUY amount, recipient, direct Portal selector, inputToken, permit mode and minOutput/slippage policy
fields.source: Explicit runtime policy required; direct fixture: native input 0.15 BNB, minOutput 6e24, empty permit; these are test values, not new trading authorization
fields.invalidation: User policy, wallet, budget, slippage or route change
fields.recompute: Resolve configuration outside hotpath into immutable profile/templates
fields.guard: Missing policy or new spender/recipient/permit mode => SKIP; do not adopt historical zero minOutput as policy

fields.field: Current quote, expected acquisition, minOutputAmount and deadline admissibility
fields.source: Pinned semantics + launch-derived/current curve state + cached converter/pool state + user amount/slippage policy
fields.invalidation: Any dependent state-version or ordering change, expiry/fee/tax branch change
fields.recompute: Compute exact integer quote locally and policy minimum floor(expected*(10000-slippageBps)/10000); revalidate snapshot before handoff
fields.guard: Minimum is a revert guard, not a guarantee of inclusion/acquisition; stale/missing input => SKIP

fields.field: Wallet nonce, native/token balances, allowances, gas price/fee cap and gas-limit profile
fields.source: Required execution-envelope inputs, not measured as a live sender in G0.2; historical caller-specific reads are inventoried
fields.invalidation: Own TX/replacement/receipt/reorg, balance/allowance change, fee policy/state change
fields.recompute: Local nonce reservation and current wallet/fee snapshot; reconciliation happens outside hotpath
fields.guard: Missing/stale data, insufficient funds, nonce conflict or new fee-exemption mapping => SKIP

fields.field: Wallet identity/signing context, serialization templates, ready sender connection
fields.source: Future G0.3/G0.5 prerequisites, not implemented/tested in G0.2
fields.invalidation: Wallet/key/chain/profile change, sender disconnect or transport change
fields.recompute: Load/validate configuration and establish DNS/TCP/TLS outside hotpath
fields.guard: Unready signer/transport => SKIP, never connect or load keys on entry path

fields.field: Final nonce reservation, dependent field patching, signature, serialization and transport handoff
fields.source: Future harness boundary only; G0.2 establishes necessary inputs, not sender performance
fields.invalidation: Snapshot invalidation, nonce race, expired local deadline or connection failure
fields.recompute: Local operations only after all guards; nonblocking telemetry outside decision critical path
fields.guard: No synchronous RPC/HTTP/DB/filesystem/DNS; signing/sending remain unimplemented and unmeasured in G0.2
